## 00:00 Afterward they enjoyed a great luxury: Rick…

Afterward they enjoyed a great luxury: Rick had room service bring up coffee. %%rf:0.80%%

He sat for a long time in the green and black and gold chair by the window, looking out. %%rf:5.40%%

(Silence) %%rf:12.10%%

## 02:41 The phone rang and he answered it…

The phone rang and he answered it, still holding the cup. %%rf:161.25%%

"It's done," he said, "and I don't want to talk about it." %%rf:166.90%%
